Make an instance match the project: its plugins from happyview.lock, then its lexicons, scripts and
modules

Usage: hpy happyview deploy [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json           Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --url <URL>      The instance, e.g. https://api.example.com (default: HPY_HV_URL, else the
                       only one you are signed in to)
      --dry-run        Show what would change on the instance without changing it
      --no-input       Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need
                       --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>             Run as if started in DIR
      --prune-plugins  Also uninstall interpreters and libraries that happyview.lock doesn't list
  -y, --yes            Do not ask for confirmation
  -h, --help           Print help
